captions.detailed: This 3D model features a corner-mount CCTV camera assembly. It consists of a dark grey, angled corner-mounting bracket, a triangular galvanized steel reinforcement plate, and a horizontal cylindrical arm extending forward. At the end of the arm, a light grey dome camera housing is suspended from a U-shaped yoke. The camera assembly articulates via a vertical revolute joint for panning and a horizontal revolute joint on the yoke for tilting.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a corner-mount CCTV camera arm with a diagonal mounting plate. The assembly should feature a horizontal support arm, a vertical panning joint at the end of the arm, and a tilting dome camera housing mounted inside a U-shaped yoke.
captions.factory: The code constructs the model using three main parts. First, the base is created by combining extruded angled plates for the corner mount and a triangular plate for the arm support. Second, the arm is built from a horizontal cylinder with collar details and a vertical cylindrical pivot cap. Third, the camera assembly is modeled using a U-shaped yoke, a central cylindrical pivot, and a hemispherical dome camera body, all connected using revolute joint definitions for pan and tilt rotations.
